intro: Write your events here: they are handed as they are to whatever shows them (for example the schedule, once this source is ticked in its “Data sources”). Times are those of the {tz} time zone.
none: No event yet. Fill in the form below.
confirmDelete: Delete this event? This cannot be undone.
hTime: For example 21:00. Leave empty for an all-day event.
hEndDate: Only if the event ends on another day. For an all-day event: the last day.
hCategory: For a stream: the name of the game.
hCancelled: A cancelled event stays in the list; the schedule decides whether to show it (struck through) or not.
hRepeatDays: For “Every week”: for example Mon, Wed, Fri. Empty = the day of the start date.
hRepeatCount: With no date and no number, the repeat goes on until you delete it.
errStartDate: The start date is not valid.
errStartTime: The start time is not valid (example: 21:00), or tick “All day”.
errEndDate: The end date is not valid.
errEndTime: The end time is not valid (example: 23:30). An end date needs an end time too.
errEndBeforeStart: The end must come after the start.
errUrl: The link must start with http:// or https://.
errDays: Days not recognised: write for example Mon, Wed, Fri.
errUntil: The end date of the repeat is not valid or comes before the start.
errCount: The number of repeats must be between 1 and 520.
errMax: You reached the limit of {n} events: delete the oldest ones.
